code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = []
    # A separator is a uniform full row/column with nonuniform data on both sides.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and r > 0 and r < h - 1:
            above = [v for line in grid[:r] for v in line]
            below = [v for line in grid[r+1:] for v in line]
            if len(set(above)) > 1 and len(set(below)) > 1:
                candidates.append((r, "h"))
    for c in range(w):
        if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and c > 0 and c < w - 1:
            left = [row[j] for row in grid for j in range(c)]
            right = [row[j] for row in grid for j in range(c+1, w)]
            if len(set(left)) > 1 and len(set(right)) > 1:
                candidates.append((c, "v"))
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError("separator not found")
    # The task separator is the only full line separating two patterned regions.
    i, axis = candidates[0]
    if axis == "h":
        region = [row[:] for row in grid[i+1:]]
    else:
        region = [row[i+1:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(v for row in region for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[5 if v == background else 3 for v in row] for row in region]
'''
